commits.purpose: Original production backend and opt-in worker hook
Original whole-update trigger KL and checkpoint identity
Fix all four r0 blockers and add regression coverage

blocker_resolutions.fix: Wall offsets are evaluated separately for each executing CAV using its current direct sensing and authorized t-1 partner sensor packets. No simulation-wide position union is supplied to moves.offsets.
blocker_resolutions.missing_report_rule: Unavailable partner positions do not cause early release. Continue the existing registered commitment until locally observed release or the original onset/hold expiry, without extrapolation or new behavioural thresholds.
tests: Production episode_components/controller regression: separated unobserved c2 crossing -101 to -100 leaves c1 action, local features and move offset invariant at t319; original t320 expiry retained.
Wall release accepts an authorized t-1 partner report and ignores a stale report.

blocker_resolutions.fix: Clean-run training consumes per-CAV observable-neighbourhood real SUMO rewards from P2 track2_reward output. Both residual-layer PPO and categorical trigger PPO retain CAV identity and distinct reward targets; scalar group-credit broadcasting is removed.
blocker_resolutions.dense_and_wm_credit: Disabled. Enabled dense_teacher/group_credit config or nonempty labels/credit train arguments refuse before optimization, including SUMO-verified dense labels.
tests: B/R real-model updates with own and observable CAV/HDV neighbour reward inputs, reversed P2 row ordering, registered weight/provenance and frozen-base assertions.
Equal-mean rewards assigned to different CAVs produce different residual and trigger parameter updates, detecting scalar reduction/broadcast regressions.
Missing, duplicate, mismatched, nonfinite, unobserved-neighbour and incorrectly weighted reward rows refuse before either optimizer.
Test-only P2 module exercises lazy reward_update integration identically for B/R; absent P2 raises an explicit dependency error.
A uses real inherited PPO with no P2 reward module and no cooperation/bank path; joint layer/trigger KL rejection restores weights and Adam state.

blocker_resolutions.fix: The practice dependency now requires a v2 augmentation manifest and each child's own sealed accepted SUMO receipt, admitted cooperative per-seed example, chosen-plan/tape binding, state/derived-snapshot/world/seed/arm alignment and existing prelaunch branch charges. P1 gates the consumer on the compliant dependency and registered parent provenance.
blocker_resolutions.budget: The shared parent prelaunch ledger phase must remain within its registered allocation, at most 200000 sim-s. Each receipt branch is charged at its full recorded branch cost. P1 requires row.prelaunch to equal cfg.augmentation_prelaunch.
blocker_resolutions.resume: Frozen augmented rows revalidate evidence through load_snapshot before collection/replay; old rows without evidence refuse. Admitted children are not duplicated as ordinary bank rows in weighted sampling.
tests: WM-only, missing, failed, wrong-world, wrong-snapshot, wrong-arm, wrong-plan, wrong-seed, unadmitted and wrong-hash children refuse identically for B/R.
Absent, wrong-phase, undercharged and overdrawn prelaunch evidence refuses.
Verified child reaches the real practice wave; frozen child with removed evidence refuses before replay; P1 refuses an old dependency or unregistered frozen child.

blocker_resolutions.fix: The CPU package fixture models absence of Git markers outside its own temporary sandbox while preserving all markers inside it. Production v2v_launch3 provenance checks are unchanged.
tests: Both enclosing .git directory and worktree-pointer-file cases still refuse package fallback when Git is unavailable.
All three previously failing v2v_live budget assertions pass in the complete selected suite, without deselection.

api.build_arm_runtime(cfg, arm): Returns production hooks: runtime, policy, policy_factory, bank_pairs, collect_update, safety, train_update, save_checkpoint, episode_components. Building hooks dispatches no physics.
api.collect_update(cfg, arm, u): Uses the real accel_runner/accel_plant V2V path. B/R steps include track2, track2_trigger, coop_layer and authorized reward_neighbourhoods receipts.
hook_order: Build with cfg.update=u; collect A before same-update B/R safety references.
Obtain P2 track2_reward output and call hooks.train_update(episodes, rewards=envelope), or omit rewards to invoke P2 reward_update lazily.
Send optimizer/reward/practice diagnostics to the parent monitor; save_checkpoint. Publish practice update_report before R requests B's realized practice count.

P2_dependency.function: reward_update(cfg, arm, u, episodes) -> reward envelope
P2_dependency.availability: Absent on this branch. Explicit integration dependency; tests supply only a local fake. No production WM-credit or synthetic-reward fallback exists.
P2_dependency.alignment: Join by episode_id,time_s,cav_id; require exactly every eligible own-action CAV row. Neighbour IDs equal sample.track2.reward_neighbourhoods[cav_id], including sensed/reported HDVs. Trigger member order must match the sample.
P2_dependency.formula: reward = own_reward + weight * mean(neighbour_rewards); empty observable neighbourhood contributes zero.
P2_dependency.learning: Direct per-CAV reward targets for layer and trigger, without cross-CAV scalar reduction. Layer uses marginal Gaussian PPO scores with inherited exact correlated joint KL; trigger retains its whole-update joint categorical KL cap. Base remains frozen.

required_bank_arm_config: track2_reward={weight: finite registered number, provenance: nonempty registration reference}; common B/R object
api.augmentation: See tools/coopmwm/PRACTICE_WEIGHTING.md for v2 evidence fields. cfg.augmentation_prelaunch must match the producer's common prelaunch registration when augmented rows are consumed.
api.disabled_clean_run_paths: dense_teacher=false, group_credit=false, extra coop_reward=false; no nonempty labels or credit arguments.
api.bank: Inherited per_seed_v1 cooperative-only effective imitation, separate full-pass optimizer, explicit registered 1.2 acceleration cap and frozen base.
api.practice: Inherited frozen plans, effective fraction, repeat cap, own-bank states, R=B realized count, prefix stripping and matched pre-update A safety references.
api.accounting: Own run_root ledger/claim, registered total <=5000000, train phase defaults to track2_train, prior charge at least parity960. Parent allocations include smoke and practice references.
api.approval: Collection requires OWNER_APPROVAL.json approved=true; supplied approval SHA is verified. Parent registration/source/launch gates still apply.
api.checkpoint: Normal arm_checkpoint_u plus B/R arm_track2_u sidecars with strict arm/update and Adam restoration; exclusive writes.
api.horizon: Unchanged 1200 sim-s episode charge, t300..1199 control loop, registered move onset/hold and inherited look-ahead.
api.default_off: Existing conditional accel_plant hook and exact-object off path retained; A unchanged; zero-init action bytes/RNG parity and base freezing remain tested.
